pass: R106 — super-ultra reference convergence master pass (recovery): macro form curved and pumped, micro form crystalline; ONE godform teardrop lower body; the clay sculpt test added as a debug view and used as the gate for every geometry batch
references: reference/mrmah-refL-r106-godform-plate.png (male front + rear plate, detail strips, clay studies) — the SILHOUETTE and lower-body authority
operatingSystem: MODE A: measure (5% grid on the plate) -> batch edit -> clay render (?debug=clay, new) front / rear / side / three-quarter + 3x microscope crops -> reject or keep; six batches; MODE B (verify, tests, proof set) only on the kept state

plateMeasurement.units: full width as a fraction of character height; t from the head apex (0) to the point (1); read by hand off the grid (scratch grid.mjs) — the automatic profile failed on the sheet's labels, as it did on R102

ratios.neckHeight: 0.015 of height — the head sits DOWN on the traps

renderMeasurement.method: character-only body mask (groups view, world hidden, low tier), refwidth.mjs central run
renderMeasurement.note: the waist already matched the plate, so every lower-body row was re-widened against it; the head stays canonical (0.24 of height against the plate's 0.175), which is why the shoulders remain proportionally wider than the plate's and hip/shoulder sits at 0.45 rather than 0.74 — the V is still upper-body dominant. Knee and calf were then deliberately held a little under the plate so the taper reads as ONE convergence with a calf swell on it rather than a thigh bulb over a calf bulb (batch 5).

batches.b1: teardrop rows (hip 0.180 -> 0.290, knee 0.124 -> 0.188, calf 0.162 -> 0.200, a 0.280 ring for the straight cone); ab bulge / crease 0.42 / -0.06 -> 0.24 / 0.06; pec-under ring d 0.236 -> 0.272; sternum 0.36 -> 0.30, pec lobe broader and lower; deltoid grooves 0.12 -> 0.045; bicep / groove / brachialis 0.52 / 0.36 / 0.30 -> 0.44 / 0.22 / 0.22; neck base up to 2.228
batches.verdict: kept — the plate slots across the chest and abdomen were gone in clay; the lower body read as ONE mass but as a vase

batches.b2: subclavicleShape takes trapK, the traps become a slope (0.17 / 0.30 / 0.85x / 0.55x across four rings; was 0.72 on one ring — a ledge); 2.100 d 0.250 -> 0.285 (the black slot under the collarbone); a 1.935 pec crown ring; ribcage +4%; the widest lower row moved down and the diagonal out of the belt straightened
batches.verdict: kept — the shoulder-line lid went; the pec turned into a dome with a lit crown

batches.b3: quad heads 0.24 -> 0.34, seam 0.36, glute pair 0.22 -> 0.40 with a 0.25 cleft; zc offsets so the glutes sit back and the knee forward
batches.verdict: kept — the lower body reads as anatomy in clay from behind and the front seam shades

batches.b4: the back's depth made monotonic to the shoulder line (the 1.935 crown had bulged the back too); three-phalanx fingers, palm 0.138 -> 0.120, digits 0.124 -> 0.172; relaxed curl 0.56 -> 0.40
batches.verdict: kept for the back; the palm still a paddle, the elbow drum's disc showed

batches.b5: continuous convergence below the thigh (calf 0.196 -> 0.180); scapular planes on the chest rings; palm 0.088 half-width, digits 0.160 x 0.024; elbow sized to the upper arm
batches.verdict: kept except the elbow — a drum sized to the upper arm showed its disc outside the bend

batches.b6: the elbow as a BALL (profile 0.5 + 0.5 sin, discs inside both tubes) at 0.78 of the upper arm; knee / calf nudged back up (0.178 / 0.190); crystal precession; mist a tenth of the theme

curvatureAndNegativeSpace.frontSilhouetteConvexity: the belt -> thigh diagonal is one straight line into a convex arc that converges to the point (16-silhouette-front-vs-plate.png); no second bulb
curvatureAndNegativeSpace.negativeSpace: the armpit triangle and the gap between the lowered arm and the thigh both survive (12-chat-mode.png at phone scale)
curvatureAndNegativeSpace.clayCorrugation: 0 horizontal slots on the front torso in clay (was 4: two ab creases, the under-pec crease, the clavicle groove)

themeCheck.note: the platinum reads silver under all three; the theme lives in the emitters, the rims, the core light of the taper, and now a tenth of the mist

engineering.staticSuite: 361/361 (four R99-R101 regexes loosened to the new arm and deltoid values; 19 R106 contracts added)
engineering.draws: unchanged — the three-phalanx hand is still one merged geometry; one loft ring added to the torso (0.280) and one to the chest (1.935)
engineering.notEvidence: headless Chromium on SwiftShader; not device evidence

openItems: the band under the neck (2.172-2.228) still faces up and catches the key as a lit collar; it is the trapezius' top and the plate lights it too, but it is brighter than the plate's

the plate's knee (0.128) and calf (0.135) are a third wider than this build's; held under on purpose for the single convergence — if the lower leg reads thin at phone scale, widen 0.780 / 0.640 together
the fingers are merged geometry and do not animate; finger micro-motion needs per-digit meshes (a draw-count cost) or a vertex-shader bend
torso respiration is carried by the core light and glow pulse, not by geometry; a geometric breath was judged too close to the rubber deformation the brief rules out
the female variant took the shared shape changes (trap slope, pec dome, ab de-corrugation) but her own ring table was not re-morphed this pass
